story_log.title: Colorado survives Georgia Tech in wild finish — Julian Lewis TD with 37 seconds left, blocked FG seals 14-13 win
story_log.development: Colorado trailed 13-7, Julian Lewis threw go-ahead TD with 37 seconds left, Georgia Tech drove for game-winning FG that got blocked—Colorado survives 14-13 on opening Thursday night per ESPN/ClutchPoints/PatMcAfeeShow. GT 100-yard kick return TD and multiple special teams mistakes. RedditCFB: GT deserved to lose after disaster class of mismanagement.

story_log.title: Louisiana judge clears ex-NFL players to return to LSU — SEC responds by suing LSU in federal court same day
story_log.development: CONTINUING [Day 8]: Louisiana state judge granted injunction allowing two former NFL players to return to LSU per ESPN/SportsCenter—same day, SEC sued LSU in U.S. District Court in Alabama alleging university violating league's First Amendment right of expressive association per ESPN/Shams. Judge ruling clears path for ex-pros to play Saturday vs Clemson. Kiffin can now roster two former NFL players when Tigers open season.

story_log.title: UMass shocks Rutgers 45-29 as 29.5-point underdog, snaps nation's longest losing streak to FBS opponents — Rutgers sets off fireworks anyway
story_log.development: UMass (0-12 last season, 29.5-point underdog) beat Rutgers on road 45-29 per ESPN/StatMuse/HaterReport—snapped 16-game losing streak. Rutgers paid UMass $1.5M to play them, then lost, then set off pre-planned postgame fireworks show anyway per NFLMemes/HaterReport. Center snapped ball thinking QB was under center—he was not—per JomboyMedia. UMass players wildin' after first win in 677 days per HaterReport.

story_log.title: Alexander Zverev survives back-to-back five-setters to open US Open — first men's No. 1 seed in Open Era to play consecutive 5-setters
story_log.development: Zverev (No. 1 seed) survived second straight five-setter in second round after dropping set 2 vs Quentin Halys per ESPN/ClutchPoints—first men's No. 1 seed in Open Era to play back-to-back 5-setters to start a major per ESPN. Unseeded Karen Khachanov upset No. 3 Felix Auger-Aliassime in second round per ESPN.

story_log.title: Nick Kyrgios cleared to return to tennis after positive cocaine test ruled out-of-competition — 31-year-old former Wimbledon runner-up free to play
story_log.development: Kyrgios (31-year-old former Wimbledon runner-up) tested positive for cocaine while playing ATP 250 event in Mallorca in June per ESPN—anti-doping authorities ruled test was out-of-competition, free to return to tennis per ESPN. Tested positive for drug during tournament.

story_log.title: MLB wild card races: Adley Rutschman's emotional return to Camden Yards, Teoscar walkoff for Dodgers, PCA keeps MVP pace
story_log.development: Rutschman (now Red Sox) got standing ovation from Orioles fans in return to Camden Yards, hit 2 HRs (first multi-HR game for Boston) per JomboyMedia/TalkinBaseball/StatMuse. Teoscar Hernandez walkoff for Dodgers vs Cardinals per TalkinBaseball. PCA hit leadoff HR vs Brewers per TalkinBaseball—now has 39 HRs (2nd in MLB), 5th in SB, only player in top 10 in both per StatMuse. UMass (29.5-point underdog) beat Rutgers on road to snap 16-game losing streak. Tarik Skubal allowed career-high-tying 10 hits vs Cardinals per TalkinBaseball. Louis Varland: 0.00 ERA last 10 games (11.0 IP), lowest ERA in majors this season (min. 50 IP) per StatMuse. Corey Seager took Shane McClanahan deep per TalkinBaseball. Nick Sogard clutch RBI single gave Red Sox first lead since 1st inning per TalkinBaseball. Cal Quantrill 7.0 shutout innings vs Rays per TalkinBaseball. Craig Kimbrel puked on mound as Marlins ran commercial for injury law firm per TalkinBaseball/JomboyMedia. Pete Alonso and Luis Robert Jr. went back-to-back per TalkinBaseball.

story_log.development: Levis (waived by Titans on Aug. 31) worked out for Jets per Pelissero. Jets looking at QB depth after claiming Blake Grupe off waivers.

lead_story.topic: Colorado survives Georgia Tech in wild finish — Julian Lewis TD with 37 seconds left, blocked FG seals 14-13 win
lead_story.headline: College football is back, and it's already broken

tweets.text:
Georgia Tech's potential game-winning FG gets blocked!

What a win for Coach Prime and Colorado 🔥
COLORADO DENIES GEORGIA TECH WITH A CLUTCH FIELD-GOAL BLOCK, ESCAPING WITH A 14-13 WIN 🤯

Please tweet

HOLY COW!! What a finish

Go Buffs!!

lead_story.research_notes:
CONTINUING [Day 1]: Reader knows college football returns tonight. Today's new development is THIS SPECIFIC GAME — Colorado's survival vs Georgia Tech. Skip the season-opening setup. Lead with the finish.

Colorado trailed 13-7, Julian Lewis threw go-ahead TD with 37 seconds left, GT drove for game-winning FG that got blocked—Colorado survives 14-13. GT had 100-yard kick return TD earlier. RedditCFB called GT 'disaster class' and 'complete mismanagement at all levels.'

Research: How many Week 0/Week 1 games in CFB history have ended on a blocked field goal attempt? How many times has a team blocked a game-winning FG after scoring a go-ahead TD in the final minute? Name the most iconic blocked-kick finishes in CFB history (Michigan-Michigan State 2015, Auburn-Alabama 2013 kick-six doesn't count but that's the comp level). This finish IS the lead — not because it's Colorado, but because it's the first game and it ended THIS way.

Deion Sanders: 'I'm back' quote before the game. OLineman tried to jump over snap during PAT attempt per PatMcAfeeShow. Alberto Mendoza involved per multiple tweets. GT deserved to lose per RedditCFB after refs robbed them of 6 points earlier.

Do NOT re-explain Deion's tenure, Colorado's 3-9 season, or why this game mattered for his job status — the history shows you already covered Deion context in prior days. Cover ONLY tonight's game: the result, the hero, the blocked kick.

supporting_stories.research_notes:
UMass (0-12 last season, 29.5-point underdog) beat Rutgers on road 45-29 per ESPN/StatMuse—snapped 16-game losing streak, winless in 677 days. Rutgers PAID UMass $1.5M to play them, then lost, then set off pre-planned postgame fireworks show anyway per NFLMemes/HaterReport.

Research: What is the largest point-spread upset in college football history? Where does 29.5 points rank all-time? How many teams have been paid $1M+ to play a game and WON? Name the most iconic cupcake-upsets-the-power-conference games in CFB history (Appalachian State-Michigan 2007 is the comp).
